name: @exyconn/seo
description: Page meta for every Exyconn site, with ZERO runtime dependencies: one typed model of a page's head (title, description, canonical, robots, hreflang, Open Graph, Twitter, theme colour, JSON-LD), the schema.org builders, and one escaped, ordered renderer — so the website's server render, the tools prerender and the tools SPA cannot drift apart.
